component.name: customItem
component.script:
sub Init() m.Poster = m.top.findNode("poster") m.Label = m.top.findNode("label") m.BorderRect = m.top.findNode("BorderRect") m.FallbackRect = m.top.findNode("FallbackRect") m.LabelScrim = m.top.findNode("LabelScrim") m.top.observeField("focusPercent", "onFocusPercentChange") end sub
sub onFocusPercentChange() if m.top.focusPercent > 0.5 m.BorderRect.color = "0x35C2FFFF" m.Label.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" m.top.scale = [1.04, 1.04] else m.BorderRect.color = "0x00000000" m.Label.color = "0xE3E6EBFF" m.top.scale = [1.0, 1.0] end if end sub
sub itemContentChanged() item = m.top.itemContent
if item <> invalid if item.hdPosterUrl <> invalid and item.hdPosterUrl <> "" m.Poster.uri = item.hdPosterUrl m.Poster.visible = true m.FallbackRect.visible = false else m.Poster.uri = "" m.Poster.visible = false m.FallbackRect.visible = true end if
if item.title <> invalid and item.title <> "" m.Label.text = item.title else m.Label.text = "No Title" end if end if
m.Poster.loadDisplayMode = "scaleToZoom" updateLayout() end sub
sub updateLayout() if m.top.height > 0 And m.top.width > 0 then m.BorderRect.width = m.top.width m.BorderRect.height = m.top.height m.FallbackRect.width = m.top.width - 8 m.FallbackRect.height = m.top.height - 8 m.FallbackRect.translation = [4, 4]
m.Poster.translation = [4, 4] m.Poster.width = m.top.width - 8 m.Poster.height = m.top.height - 8
m.LabelScrim.width = m.top.width - 8 m.LabelScrim.height = 62 m.LabelScrim.translation = [4, m.top.height - 66] m.Label.width = m.top.width - 28 m.Label.height = 54 m.Label.translation = [14, m.top.height - 60] end if end sub
